page.title: FIB-4 Index
page.subtitle: Non-invasive liver fibrosis estimate from age, AST, ALT, and platelet count. Local-only calculation.

overview.title: What this tool does
overview.description: Computes the Fibrosis-4 (FIB-4) index for clinical reference inside the Utilivo WebView runtime.

points.formula: Uses the standard FIB-4 equation with age, AST, ALT, and platelets.
points.risk: Classifies into low, indeterminate, or high probability bands using common published cutoffs (1.45 and 3.25).
points.context: Interpret with full clinical context; not a standalone diagnosis.

section.title: Inputs
section.description: Enter all required values. The index updates live once the form is valid.

errors.integer: Age must be a whole number.
errors.range: Age must be between 18 and 120 years.
AST must be between 0.1 and 2000 U/L.

alt.label: ALT
alt.help: Alanine aminotransferase. Must be greater than zero (used under the square root).

errors.nonzero: ALT must be greater than zero.
errors.range: ALT must be between 0.1 and 2000 U/L.

errors.number: Platelet count must be a number.
errors.range: Platelet count must be between 1 and 1000 x10^9/L.

section.title: Result
section.description: Rounded to three decimals with standard low / indeterminate / high cutoff interpretation.

empty.body: Complete the form with valid values to calculate FIB-4.

categories.low: Low probability of advanced fibrosis (by FIB-4)
categories.high: High probability of advanced fibrosis (by FIB-4)

interpretations.low: FIB-4 is below the lower cutoff. This supports a lower likelihood of advanced fibrosis in many cohorts; correlate with the full clinical picture.
interpretations.indeterminate: FIB-4 falls between the published cutoffs. Use clinical judgment and consider further evaluation when appropriate.
interpretations.high: FIB-4 exceeds the upper cutoff. This supports a higher likelihood of advanced fibrosis in many cohorts; interpret alongside the rest of the assessment.

status.empty: Enter all required values to calculate.
status.incomplete: Complete or correct the highlighted fields to enable calculation.
status.ready: All required fields are valid. The result is updating live.

how.title: How it works
how.description: FIB-4 combines age and liver enzymes with platelet count to estimate fibrosis burden non-invasively.

alt.label: ALT
alt.value: Alanine aminotransferase in U/L; must be > 0.

items.context: Cutoffs were derived in specific populations; accuracy varies by etiology and setting.
items.cutoffs: This tool uses 1.45 and 3.25 as commonly cited boundaries; age-adjusted cutoffs may apply in some guidelines.
items.diagnosis: FIB-4 is not a standalone diagnosis.

section.title: References
section.description: Primary derivation and secondary calculator references.

items.sterling: Sterling RK, Lissen E, Clumeck N, et al. Development of a simple noninvasive index to predict significant fibrosis in patients with HIV/HCV coinfection. Hepatology. 2006;43(6):1317-1325.

footer.disclaimer: For clinical decision support only. Not a diagnosis. Use alongside professional judgment.
